_what: Where the engine finds the product it runs (src/account_files/identity.rs). The engine ships no product word, host, Workshop source or secret helper: the launcher of this computer writes them in one product settings file and hands the engine its absolute path in the launch setting `launch_setting` (an environment variable), a regular file of at most `max_bytes`. The file holds `word` (the identity word: the vault's key context and secret-name prefix, the execution account files, header and item names; changing it changes every sealed handle, so it never changes for a product that has data), `site_host`, `app_host`, `brand_mark_path` and `restore_placeholder_owner`, plus at most the `sections` below, each read by its own owner: `secret_home` (src/secrets.rs: where this computer keeps its secrets, `{kind, program, missing_status, unnamed_account}`), `root_credentials_folder` (src/account_source.rs: the relative folder in the home that holds a restore receipt's root credential files), `tools_source` (src/tool_runs/tools.rs `from_data`, read by src/tool_runs/tools/install.rs: `{repository, first_start_commit, archive, source_hosts}`), `hosting_app_report` (src/account/computers.rs: the hosting app's own computer report), `carried_from` (src/secrets.rs: the old vault layout a one-time carry reads; absent, nothing is carried), `host_event_kinds` (src/wake/host_events.rs: the kinds of event this computer's shell sends, `{kind: {payload: [field]}}`; absent, none is kept), `new_accounts` (src/native_boot.rs `Selection::sign_in_rules`: the starting rows the hosting app writes, once, into an account that opens without them, the same shape as a computer config's `new_accounts`, src/account/sign_in.rs `StartingRows`; absent, nothing is written) `sign_up_hosting` (src/account_files/sign_up_hosting.rs: `{operator_account, hosting_computers: [{origin, public_key}]}`, the operator account the email index lives in and the computers that host sign-ups; absent, no email is claimed), and `page_look` (src/account/sign_in/shell.rs `Look`: the look every sign-in page wears, the app's own page shell as DATA; absent, pages are drawn with no look), and `public_screen_copy` (src/workspace_publication.rs `Placement`: the storage supply binding and bucket the preserved public saved-screen copy must declare, its layout names and ceilings; absent, that copy is unavailable). A start without a readable file names this setting and refuses whatever needs the product.
